attribution: Instituto Geográfico Nacional de la República Argentina (IGN)
license_evidence: Current IGN demarcation-layer metadata states free use of the information with appropriate citation of IGN. The repository does not redistribute the 140 MB WFS response; it re-fetches and verifies the exact snapshot hash.
identity_note: in1 is the complete five-digit administrative code in the observed IGN department layer and is unique for all 529 features. gid is also preserved as the service/database feature identifier. Names are not unique and are never used as identity.
known_limitations: IGN exposes this layer as a live WFS without a formal immutable release identifier; this Geography Release is therefore addressed by the exact 2026-08-26 retrieval time, request URL, raw-byte SHA-256 and normalized content hash.
The layer contains Departamento, Partido and Comuna labels under one second-order administrative layer; the source vocabulary is preserved rather than collapsed.
The source extent includes Argentina's bicontinental/Antarctic representation to latitude -90. A Census relation is expected to leave administrative targets outside Census coverage unreferenced.
The fdc field records multiple upstream provincial/IGN capture lineages. Those values are preserved and do not imply uniform boundary provenance across all rows.
Administrative names are not unique. Consumers must use native_id/in1 or geo_uid, not fna/nam, for identity.
This release does not assert that IGN boundaries supersede, repair or replace Census statistical geography.
